title: Creuss home system on the board
description: The Creuss home system (tile 51) has no hex on the ordinary map, and the host never sent it as a map tile, so the board did not draw it: its ships, planet and control could not be seen or clicked (while the engine offered it for activation). The host now sends it as an off-map tile on a free hex beside the Creuss Gate, wherever the Gate is after tile edits (a Muaat supernova shown here). The capture asserts it is drawn in the viewport, is the topmost element at its centre, and that click -> inspector -> Confirm submits 51, desktop and 390x844.

shots.heading: Before: desktop
shots.caption: The Creuss Gate is on the map, but the home system is not drawn anywhere, although it is a legal activation.

shots.heading: After: desktop
shots.caption: Tile 51 sits beside the Gate facing away from the centre, with the Creuss carrier and infantry on it. A Muaat supernova (Nova Seed) is on the map too.

shots.heading: After: picked, desktop
shots.caption: Clicking the Creuss home opens its inspector with Confirm activation.

shots.heading: Before: phone
shots.caption: No Creuss home on the phone board.

shots.heading: After: phone
shots.caption: Tile 51 is drawn and inside the viewport.

shots.heading: After: picked, phone
shots.caption: Tapping the Creuss home opens the inspector.

notes.title: Host change
notes.text: ti4-host map.rs: build_board_tiles lists off-map systems; with_recorded_edits places them beside the Gate and adds ones missing from older stored games. No engine rule changed, so no rules version.

notes.text: Fixtures mirror the host output for a Creuss table (tile data printed from the Rust test).
